rows.en:
Well, we can't just sit here staring blankly
at the sea forever, so shall we start
getting ready to head home?
Let's do that.
rows.notes: Male; x2 (frd_yui_005 and frd_yui_006); as c08074.

rows.en:
(I had a lot of fun with Hoshimura today.
It was a nice change of pace.)

(I came to the artificial island
with Yui again, but...)
Hey, Yui, let's hurry up and go swimming.

(Weird stuff...?
Was it really that embarrassing for her......)

Okay... I swear I'll never say 'cute,'
so let's hurry up and go play.
(Then what am I supposed to do...)

(I had a lot of fun with Yui today.
It was a nice change of pace.)

(Today I'm going to enjoy some shopping
at Folmo with Hoshimura!)

(Huh? Wait...
Hoshimura got here first? That's unusual.)
Sorry, Hoshimura. Did I keep you waiting?

Hmph! You're late!
Just how long were you planning
to keep me waiting?

Sorry, sorry...
Wait, it's still ten minutes before
the time we said we'd meet......
Oops, busted.
Geez, don't startle me like that.

Still, for you not to be late, Hoshimura,
and even show up early... That's unusual.
Did something happen?

...Hmm~?
I just kinda woke up early, and waiting at home
was boring, so I figured I'd head out early.

Getting to a meetup first once in a while
isn't so bad, huh?
Even the waiting is kinda fun.

...But anyway, enough of that.
Shall we be off to enjoy some shopping, then?
Here, Hoshimura.
rows.notes: Male; handing her an ice cream (see c14462).

rows.en: What's with the 'Huh?' Why so surprised?
rows.notes: Male; her "heh?" is not a separate row here.

rows.en:
You always eat my ice cream without asking,
right, Hoshimura? So this time,
I'm offering it to you first...
rows.notes: Male (saki ni douzo). Reading of saki ni douzo: the player offers her the ice cream first because she always eats his; it could also mean he bought her one of her own.

rows.en:
Oh, come on!
When have I ever done something that greedy?

Last time we came here...
Actually, I think you do it every time...?
Uhh... Did I?
You did.

I-I think I'll pass today~
I'm already full anyway...

What! Hoshimura turning something down?
That's a first. Are you feeling sick or something?

Nah, I'm super healthy!
Boundless energy is Yui-san's selling point,
after all!

...Is what I'd like to say, but...
I'm kinda not myself today, am I......

What's going on with me?
Being with you is fun, and yet...?
Hmm... Shall we just go home for today?

Let's do that. Looks like you're not quite
yourself today either, Hoshimura.
Yeah, sorry. See ya.

(Hmm, Hoshimura wasn't her usual self today.
What on earth is going on with her?)

(I hope Hoshimura goes back to her
usual energetic self soon...)

at Folmo with Yui!)

(Huh? Wait...
Yui got here first? That's unusual.)

Geez, don't startle me like that.

and even show up early... That's unusual.
Did something happen?
Here, Yui.
What's with the 'Huh?' Why so surprised?

You always eat my ice cream without asking,
right, Yui? So this time,
I'm offering it to you first...

Let's do that. Looks like you're not quite

(I hope Yui goes back to her
usual energetic self soon...)

(I came to Folmo by myself today,
but maybe I should've invited Hoshimura too.)
(All right, I'll try giving Hoshimura a call.)

Hello hello, Yui here~
And to whom am I speaking, pray tell?

Oh, Hoshimura.
It's \p.
If you're free, want to come to Folmo now?

Uhh, well, ummm...
Sorry, I'm actually super busy right now.

Oh, you've got something to do...
Well, can't be helped, then.

S-sorry...
Invite me again next time! Okay, bye! Later!

(And here I wanted to hang out with Hoshimura...
Oh well, guess I'll have fun on my own......)
